title: Boundary determination from local boundary data for a fractional Calderón problem
summary: We introduce a new Calderón-type problem for fractional powers of Schrödinger operators, with local boundary conditions. The associated Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator maps Dirichlet data to Neumann data on the boundary. We show that this operator determines the Taylor series of the potential at the boundary. In particular, analytic potentials are uniquely determined. These are the first results for a fractional Calderón problem with sources and measurements on the boundary.
